name: International Rescue Committee
summary: Humanitarian aid organisation; GiveWell funds its malnutrition treatment and vaccination work.

lines.label: Vaccination incentives
lines.source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/International-Rescue-Committee-IRC-Desk-Based-Scoping-of-Programs-to-Increase-Vaccination-Coverage-September-2024%29 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): scoping Sep 2024 $150,000 + vaccination outreach in Salamat and Sila, Chad, Apr 2026 $3,511,707 (https://airtable.com/appaVhon0jdLt1rVs/shrixNMUWCSC5v1lh/tblykYPizxzYj3U1L/viwJ3DyqAUsL654Rm).

lines.label: Malnutrition treatment
lines.source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/international-rescue-committee-malnutrition-treatment-january-2024 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): acute malnutrition Jan 2024 $7,485,323 + Apr 2025 $7,992,256 + Jan 2026 $8,833,269 (https://airtable.com/appaVhon0jdLt1rVs/shrixNMUWCSC5v1lh/tblykYPizxzYj3U1L/viwJ3DyqAUsL654Rm).

lines.label: Other programmes (crisis response, recovery and development; resettlement, asylum and integration)
lines.source: https://www.rescue.org/irc-document/irc-financial-statement-fy-2025 (total program services $1,141,420 thousand less the vaccination and malnutrition grants above; the accounts split programmes only into crisis response, recovery and development $753,979 thousand and resettlement, asylum and integration $387,441 thousand)

spending.source: https://www.rescue.org/irc-document/irc-financial-statement-fy-2025 (audited consolidated statement of functional expenses, year ended September 30 2025, amounts in thousands: total program services $1,141,420 thousand of $1,329,749 thousand total operating expenses; crisis response, recovery and development $753,979 thousand, resettlement, asylum and integration $387,441 thousand)
